questions.question: True or False: Ipswich Town finished 5th in the Premier League during the 2000–01 season as a newly promoted club.
questions.anchorClues: Managed by George Burley, newly promoted Ipswich Town finished 5th in 2000–01 to qualify for the UEFA Cup, with Marcus Stewart scoring 19 league goals.

questions.question: Which player holds the all-time record for receiving the most yellow cards in Premier League history, accumulating 123 cautions?
questions.anchorClues: Gareth Barry collected 123 yellow cards across 653 Premier League appearances for Aston Villa, Manchester City, Everton, and West Bromwich Albion.

questions.question: Which manager led Southampton to an 8th-place Premier League finish and the FA Cup Final during the 2002–03 campaign?
questions.anchorClues: Gordon Strachan guided Southampton to 8th place in the league and an FA Cup Final appearance against Arsenal in 2003.

questions.question: Who scored the first Premier League goal in Swansea City's history following their promotion in 2011?
questions.anchorClues: Scott Sinclair converted a penalty against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge on 24 September 2011 to score Swansea's first-ever Premier League goal.

questions.question: Which club scored a record 106 goals during the 2017–18 season to set the all-time Premier League single-season goalscoring benchmark?
questions.anchorClues: Pep Guardiola's Manchester City scored 106 goals while accumulating 100 points during their 'Centurions' campaign in 2017–18.

questions.question: Who scored the first goal for Middlesbrough at the Riverside Stadium upon its opening in August 1995?
questions.anchorClues: Craig Hignett scored after 39 minutes against Chelsea on 26 August 1995 to open Middlesbrough's account at the Riverside Stadium.

questions.question: Which manager was at the helm of Charlton Athletic for 15 years, establishing them in the Premier League after winning promotion in 1998?
questions.anchorClues: Alan Curbishley managed Charlton Athletic from 1991 to 2006, guiding them into the top flight twice and establishing them as a Premier League staple.

questions.question: Which player broke the record by scoring in 11 consecutive Premier League appearances during the 2015–16 season?
questions.anchorClues: Jamie Vardy scored in 11 straight matches for Leicester City between August and November 2015, breaking Ruud van Nistelrooy's record of 10.

questions.question: Which referee issued 12 yellow cards during the infamous 'Battle of the Bridge' fixture between Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur in May 2016?
questions.anchorClues: Mark Clattenburg officiated the 2–2 draw at Stamford Bridge, booking nine Tottenham players and three Chelsea players as Leicester secured the title.

questions.question: Who was the first non-European player to win a Premier League Golden Boot, sharing the award in the 1998–99 season with 18 goals?
questions.anchorClues: Trinidad & Tobago forward Dwight Yorke scored 18 goals for Manchester United in 1998–99 to share the Golden Boot with Hasselbaink and Owen.
